description: Default label of a Circular similarity ring whose comparison file names no label (FASTA, or a flat file without DEFINITION and organism): the file name without its last extension (D-03). tests/test_comparison_sequences.py runs gbdraw.io.comparison_sequences.read_comparison_sequence_file and tests/web/conservation-series.test.mjs runs the Web defaultConservationSeriesLabel on every case; both must give the expected label.
